en.name: Valkyrie
en.ability: Each night*, deaths are delayed until you approve the list of deaths. If you don't approve it, only you die tonight.

revisions.v1: Each night*, deaths are delayed until you approve the list of deaths. If you don't approve it, only you die tonight.

en.otherNightReminder: Point to every player due to die tonight. The Valkyrie nods to approve, or shakes their head to refuse.
